scope: Cross-module helper-proof synthesis inside one monorepo snapshot

tasks.title: Clamp is nonexpansive
tasks.obligation: For l <= h, prove |Clamp(x,l,h)-Clamp(y,l,h)| <= |x-y|. Immutable clients consume the distance bound and its ordered-input corollary.
targeted_negative_controls: Apply ordered-case fact without establishing order
tasks.diversity_rationale: Two-input distance bound, rather than only monotonicity or nested clamp equality.

tasks.title: Soft-threshold composition
tasks.obligation: For s,t >= 0 and Shrink(t,x)=x-t when x>t, x+t when x< -t, and 0 otherwise, prove Shrink(s,Shrink(t,x))=Shrink(s+t,x).
targeted_negative_controls: Use positive-branch contract on a negative intermediate
tasks.diversity_rationale: Piecewise intermediate values change the applicable second-stage region.

tasks.title: Saturating accumulation associativity
tasks.obligation: For c,x,y,z >= 0 and Sat(c,v)=min(c,v), prove Sat(c,Sat(c,x+y)+z)=Sat(c,x+Sat(c,y+z)).
targeted_negative_controls: Substitute x+y for Sat(c,x+y) without proving x+y<=c
tasks.diversity_rationale: Saturation and nonnegativity govern algebraic reassociation; reference length alone is not diversity.

tasks.title: Prefix aggregate split
targeted_negative_controls: Recursive call without decreasing the selected prefix
tasks.diversity_rationale: Parameter-dependent slices and two bounds; descended from existing sum/append reasoning, never a new held-out family.

tasks.title: Adjacent-run compression idempotence
tasks.obligation: For Squash that retains one item per maximal equal run, prove Squash(Squash(s))=Squash(s), using a no-adjacent-equals invariant available through protected contracts.
tasks.diversity_rationale: Interaction between output shape and the inductive invariant, not filter fusion.

tasks.title: Interleave and unweave round trip
tasks.obligation: For |xs|=|ys|, prove Left(Weave(xs,ys))=xs and Right(Weave(xs,ys))=ys. Two immutable clients check the respective projections.
targeted_negative_controls: Recurse on only one input tail
tasks.diversity_rationale: Paired sequences and mutually relevant projections replace a single append identity.

tasks.title: Bounded allocation with conservation
tasks.obligation: Given a<=b, c<=d and a+c<=T<=b+d, construct integers u in [a,b], v in [c,d] with u+v=T. Immutable clients check bounds and conservation.
targeted_negative_controls: Treat a closed boundary as strict
tasks.diversity_rationale: Coupled choice and conservation; algebraically related to interval feasibility and explicitly in that development ancestry.

tasks.title: Feasible intersection or separation certificate
tasks.obligation: For nonempty closed integer intervals, return either a common witness or a valid certificate b<c or d<a, with exhaustive and mutually sound outcomes.
targeted_negative_controls: Return a witness in only one interval
Return failure without a separation certificate
tasks.diversity_rationale: Constructive positive result plus a negative certificate; not just additional separated witnesses.

tasks.title: Witness avoiding an excluded point
tasks.obligation: For integer a<b and excluded point e, construct u with a<=u<=b and u!=e. Clients check containment and exclusion.
targeted_negative_controls: Use b+1 as the fallback witness
Return e+1 when e lies above b
tasks.diversity_rationale: Disequality changes the target and boundary branch. Deliberately simple contrast; no harder-task claim.

tasks.title: Key-swap involution
tasks.obligation: For k,j in m.Keys, prove Swap(Swap(m,k,j),k,j)=m, including k=j; clients check round trip and preservation of other keys.
targeted_negative_controls: Overwrite before preserving the old value
tasks.diversity_rationale: Two-way value dependence and round trip, rather than commuting writes of independent constants.

tasks.title: Fresh-key move composition
tasks.obligation: For distinct a,b,c with a in m.Keys and b,c absent, prove Move(Move(m,a,b),b,c)=Move(m,a,c), where Move copies the source value to a fresh destination then deletes the source.
targeted_negative_controls: Lose the source value after deletion
Fail to remove the intermediate key
tasks.diversity_rationale: Intermediate domain changes must justify a second operation and an observational equivalence.

tasks.title: Restriction distributes over disjoint merge
tasks.obligation: For disjoint domains of m and n, prove Restrict(Merge(m,n),S)=Merge(Restrict(m,S),Restrict(n,S)); preserve domains and pointwise values.
targeted_negative_controls: Confuse union and intersection in domain
Use the wrong source branch for a value
tasks.diversity_rationale: Set-domain algebra plus pointwise frame reasoning; any finite-set witness variants remain development.

tasks.title: Mirror reconstruction
tasks.obligation: Prove Mirror(Mirror(t))=t for an immutable binary-tree datatype; clients consume structural equality and preserved size.
tasks.diversity_rationale: Branching structural induction. Generic induction overlaps development; the generator and task solutions must remain disjoint.

tasks.title: Tree zipper reconstruction
tasks.obligation: For a valid root-to-subtree path, prove plugging the focused subtree into its extracted context reconstructs the original tree.
tasks.diversity_rationale: Context reconstruction and path validity, not sequence append under a renamed type.

tasks.title: Leaf frontier under mirror
tasks.obligation: Prove Leaves(Mirror(t))=Reverse(Leaves(t)), with immutable definitions and a fixed sequence API.
targeted_negative_controls: Reverse each subtree without exchanging order
Use concatenation in the wrong order
tasks.diversity_rationale: Combines tree and sequence interfaces. Reverse-concat lemma knowledge may transfer; no claim of conceptually unseen mathematics.

tasks.title: Capacity-respecting reservations
tasks.obligation: Prove an explicitly guarded Reserve/Release transition relation preserves 0<=used<=capacity over every valid trace. Clients consume safety and nonnegative remaining capacity.
targeted_negative_controls: Assume a transition guard in the wrong action case
tasks.diversity_rationale: State validity and guarded action induction; arithmetic knowledge is shared with development but not task ancestry.

tasks.title: Token lifecycle safety
tasks.obligation: For a fixed Available/Reserved/Consumed state machine and valid labeled transitions, prove a token is consumed at most once before an explicit reset action.
targeted_negative_controls: Permit consume from the wrong state
tasks.diversity_rationale: History-dependent safety requiring an explicit protected invariant, rather than a map-update identity.

tasks.title: One-slot producer-consumer refinement
tasks.obligation: Show each valid concrete trace of an Empty/Full(value) buffer maps to a valid abstract Send/Receive history with preserved value order.
targeted_negative_controls: Lose the connection between stored and received value
tasks.diversity_rationale: Simulation across two module contracts. Bounded syntax and reference feasibility remain open gates.

held_out_claim: Reserved author-visible family test, not yet implemented or certified independent; no model-pretraining novelty claim
holdout_retirement_rule: Any use of held-out reference solutions or model results to tune prompts, grammar, inference, task selection, training or hyperparameters retires that family from the primary test; retain and report the exposure.

ordering.strategy: Four Williams rows; assign row r to sample one and r+2 modulo four to sample two; balance rows across each stage; interleave families
ordering.within_family_holdout_balance: Six sample rows per held-out family cannot divide evenly among four orders; publish remaining imbalance rather than claiming perfect balance

metrics: observed call graph and targeted ablation dependence
